sections.heading: To prepare
items: Pour 4 cups hot boiling water over the rice noodles. Quickly toss the noodles, drain off the water, and set aside.
Use 1 TBS oil to stir fry the shrimp. Set the shrimp aside and stir fry the egg. Set the egg aside.
Use 4 TBS oil to stir fry the ingredients in A, adding in the order shown. Add the rice noodles, seasoning mixture B, shrimp and egg and stir fry together. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Heat 4 TBS oil in the wok. Using low heat brown the noodles evenly. Sprinkle 1 tsp salt over the noodles.
Press the noodles into a large pancake shape and continue to use low heat to keep them warm.

Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok and quickly stir fry the shrimp and then set aside. Using the same oil, brown the scallion, meat, and all the vegetables together. Add the soy sauce, salt, and broth and bring to a boil. Add the cornstarch to thicken the mixture. Add the sesame seed oil.
Place the cooked noodles on a serving plate and pour the vegetable mixture over them. Serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 chopped scallions or 1/2 cup chopped onions
1/2 cup of chopped Chinese BarBQ pork, ham, or Chinese sausage
1/4 cup of frozen peas soaked in cold water or 1 cup fresh bean sprouts

sections.heading: To Cook
items: Fry the eggs in 2 TBS hot oil until cooked and remove aside. Chop into small pieces. (Stir the eggs while you fry)
Quickly stir the shrimp in 2 TBS hot oil until cooked and remove aside.
Stir the scallions in 2 TBS hot oil until light brown. Add meat and rice together then add peas, salt and pepper. Stir until rice is thoroughly heated. Add (1) and (2), mix well. Serve hot.

sections.heading: P.S.
items: This is a good way to heat cold rice. If you like curry flavor, you may add 1 TBS curry powder to the rice while you are cooking.
If you like dark color rice, you may add 1 or 2 TBS dark soy sauce (kitchen bouquet or molasses) to get the color but use less salt.
This dish must be cooked with high heat.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 Cups uncooked rice (yields four cups cooked)

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Rinse uncooked rice right in pot until water is clear. (Rinse as many times as necessary; do not rinse through strainer.) Then add enough water to cover one inch over top of rice. Do not add any salt or butter.

Bring to boil over medium-high heat in a partially covered pot. When water boils, lower heat to medium heat and cook a while longer til water is absorbed and there are no bubbles on top of rice. If there are still bubbles, rice is not ready to turn down yet.

When all water is absorbed, turn heat to low, cover pot completely and simmer a little longer (about 10 mins.). Then turn heat off and let rice sit, covered about 10-15 mins. Only stir rice just before serving, never during cooking time.

title: Noodles with Hot Sesame Seed Sauce

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Mix all of the sauce ingredients in a serving bowl, add the soup stock and mix well.

Cook the noodles in hot boiling water for 3-5 minutes until soft and then remove to a strainer. Shake the strainer to remove excess water. Add the noodles and spinach to the sauce mixture and serve hot.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Cook the noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain. Rinse them under cold water until they cool. Shake off the excess water and set aside.
Heat 4 TBS oil in the wok. When the oil is hot pour in the sauce mixture then the noodles. Heat momentarily and then remove from the wok and let cool. Ideal dish to serve on a hot summer day.

sections.heading: Other Ingredients
items: 2 small packages of bean thread noodles

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Soak the noodles in hot water for 15 minutes and pat dry.
Use 1 TBS oil to stir fry Mixture A. Add Mixture B and stir together. Add the noodles and Mixture C and cook together, adding the soup stock as needed.
Cook until all the liquid is gone then remove to a serving plate and serve hot.

title: Cold Noodles for Hot Summer Day

sections.heading: Noodles
items: Cook and drain under cold water. Allow to drain and add 1 TBS sesame seed oil.

sections.heading: Ingredients (use varying amounts to suit your taste)
items: Egg skin-scramble eggs and fry in the shape of thin pancake, cut into strips

sections.heading: To Serve
items: Put 1 cup of noodles in a serving bowl, plus any ingredients over the meat as taste dictates or any sauce you wish.

sections.heading: Note
items: This recipe should be used as a guide. Because of the unique style and skilled technique involved in Chinese cooking it is very important to watch Jeanne's demonstration.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Wash green beans and dry with a paper towel. Cut into one-inch lengths.
Heat 6 cups oil in wok. When the oil gets hot, deep fry the green beans until wrinkled. Strain and set aside.

Heat 2 TB oil in wok. Over high heat, stir-fry mixture A until the flavor comes out. Add the green beans and stir together. Add the sauce and stir together until all absorbed. Add chopped scallions to top and serve it hot or cold.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 sticks of scallion cut into 1 inch lengths
1/4 cup frozen peas soaked in cold water
1 tsp salt (more or less to taste)

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Heat the wok with 2 TBS of cooking oil. When the oil is hot, quick stir fry the eggs until they are firm. Remove the eggs from the wok. Do not overcook the eggs.

Heat 1 TBS oil in the wok. When hot, stir fry the scallion until they are a light brown color. Add the tomatoes and stir fry for about a minute. Add the peas and the eggs and stir fry them together. Sprinkle on the salt and pepper and remove to the serving platter.

title: Zuchini and Onion with Sesame Seed

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Heat up 2 TBS cooking oil in the wok. When the oil is hot, stir fry the zuchini and onion together. If the mixture looks dry, add a small amount of hot broth or hot water a little at a time.
Add salt and sugar to taste as you continue to stir the mixture. Add the soy sauce, stir, sprinkle on the sesame seed and remove to a serving platter.

sections.heading: Note
items: Both dishes (Tomato and Egg, and Zuchini and Onion with Sesame Seed) must be cooked on high heat to retain moisture and freshness in the vegetables.

title: Sweet and Sour Lotus Root Salad

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Remove the skin from the lotus root and slice it into thin slices. Immediately soak them in cold water.
Boil the sliced lotus root in hot water for 2-3 minutes and strain the root and soak in cold water again. Chill the lotus root in water in the refrigerator until they are cold.
Shred the hot chili peppers into very thin strips and remove the seeds.

Toss the sliced root with the sauce and then arrange the slices on a serving platter with the red chili peppers sprinkled on top of the root. Heat the sesame seed oil and then brown the peppercorn until the smell comes out. Sprinkle the peppercorn over the lotus root and serve.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cook mushrooms with Mixture (A) until the liquid is gone.
Beat the egg using a slow motion and add to (A).
Add Mixture (B) to the above and mix well.
Divide into 6 portions adding chicken, shrimp, watercress and mushroom.
Steam for 15 minutes at low heat.

sections.heading: Mixture B
items: 1/2 cup Chinese barbecue pork (cut into strips)
1/2 cup uncooked shrimp or crab meat
1 cup bean sprouts, bamboo shoots (cut up) or onion

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Heat 3 TBS cooking oil and stir-fry mixture (B), adding the ingredients in the order listed. Add soy sauce and cook together for about 1 min.
Remove mixture (B) from wok and add to mixture (A).
Put 2 TBS oil in and along the sides of a medium hot wok. Put all ingredients into the wok and fry at medium heat.
Divide the egg foo-yong into 5 or 6 pieces.

sections.heading: Gravy Instructions
items: Cook on medium heat to thicken. Pour over cut up egg foo-yong mixture and serve hot.

sections.heading: C. Makisushi
items: 1/2 cup dry shrimp powder or fish powder
6 strips of spinach or water crest or pickle

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Sweet Egg Log: Mix the ingredients together in a bowl then pour into a frying pan and heat evenly until the egg has cooked into a pancake shape. Cut the egg into strips for sushi.
Sushi Rice: Mix the hot rice with all of the seasonings thoroughly then let cool before using.

Makisushi: Place the sea weed sheet on a rolling sheet. Spread the sushi rice over half the sea weed, place the filling strips on top so that when the sea weed is rolled up, they are in the middle. Cut the roll into 1 inch wide slices and serve cold.

Sushi Bean Curd: Boil the bean curd in hot water for 2 minutes. Cut the bean curds in half and place them in the soup stock-sugar-soy sauce mixture until soft and flavored. Stuff sushi rice into the bean curd and decorate with black sesame seed.
Mix all the ingredients together. Heat the oil in a special frying pan.

Pour 1/4 cup of the egg mixture into pan. As soon as it begins to set roll it up away from yourself toward the edge of the pan. Repeat this until the omelette is about 1 1/2 inches wide and 1 inch high.
Chill omelette in refrigerator for 30 min. Cut into small pieces and serve as appetizers or a side dish.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 can quail eggs cut in half

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Mix the pork, shrimp, scallion, and ginger together and mix with the seasoning sauce.
Take one skin and place one half an egg with one teaspoon of meat. Fold into a shao-my dumpling.
Place in a bamboo steamer and steam for 15 minutes. Serve with soy sauce.

sections.heading: Filling Mixture
items: 1/4 cup black mushroom soaked and chopped

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Place the flour in a bowl, add the hot water and mix well with a stick. Add the egg and enough water to make a nice workable ball of dough. Cover it with a cloth and let it rest undisturbed.
Mix the filling and the seasoning mixture together.
Divide the dough into 30 small pieces and roll into 2 inch circles with thin skin. Place 1 TBS filling mix into dough circle and shape into shao-my cups.
Place the shao-my in a steamer and steam for 10 minutes.
Tastes best when served with soy sauce and chili sauce.
